name: usched
description: High-performance USC schedule optimizer and degree audit advisor

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix client install && uv sync
scripts.api: uv run python -m server.openapi > client/.openapi.json && npm --prefix client run gen:api
scripts.serve: npm run build && uv run uvicorn server.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
scripts.lint:py: uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check .
scripts.lint: npm run lint:py && npm run lint:ts
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:py && npm run typecheck:ts
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
